description: Schedules a new maintenance window. During maintenance, the monitors in monitorIDs are suppressed and show MAINTENANCE status instead of DOWN. A window created without monitorIDs suppresses nothing. Use strategy "manual" for a window you switch on and off with resumeMaintenance / pauseMaintenance.

active.description: Whether the window is active (default: true). For a manual window, active means in maintenance right now.

cron.description: Cron expression for when the window starts, e.g. "30 3 * * *" (03:30 daily), for the cron strategy

dateRange.description: [start, end] as local wall-clock times in the window's timezone, e.g. ["2026-10-08T10:00", "2026-10-08T12:00"] — the format Uptime Kuma's own UI stores. Required for single; optional bounds for recurring strategies; ignored for manual.

daysOfMonth.description: Days of month (1-31) for recurring-day-of-month strategy

description.description: Description or reason for the maintenance

durationMinutes.description: How long each window lasts, in minutes, for the cron strategy

intervalDay.description: Interval in days for recurring-interval strategy

monitorIDs.description: IDs of the monitors this window suppresses. A window with no monitors suppresses nothing. On update this REPLACES the current list; pass [] to detach all.

strategy.description: Scheduling strategy: single=one-time, recurring-interval=every N days, recurring-weekday=specific weekdays, recurring-day-of-month=specific dates, cron=starts on a cron expression and lasts durationMinutes, manual=on whenever active

timeRange.description: Daily [{hours, minutes}, {hours, minutes}] start and end. Required for the recurring-* strategies, ignored otherwise.

timezone.description: Timezone the dates and times are in (e.g. "America/New_York", "UTC"). Omit to follow the server timezone.

weekdays.description: Days of week (0=Sunday … 6=Saturday) for recurring-weekday strategy

name: createMaintenance
title: Create Maintenance
